lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, exhibiting a semi-regular grid pattern with approximately equal spacing between centroids along the longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Prominent vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows; most high-luminance blobs are precisely centered at these vertical and horizontal intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature on the upper flank characterized by a high-contrast gradient, with higher luminance values directly above the ridge line and a shadowed low-luminance zone immediately below it.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible area of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 12 discrete, high-intensity blobs; density is highest in the lower-central region of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three smaller, elongated fish silhouettes swimming in close proximity to the ventral side of the pectoral fin.
